name: Machine Reverse-Grip High Row
steps: Sit in a high row machine facing the chest pad with your feet planted firmly and grip the high handles using an underhand palms-up grip.
Set your chest firmly against the pad and let your arms extend upward and forward into a full lat stretch.
Pull the handles downward and back toward your lower ribs while keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Extend your arms slowly back to the starting stretch under full control.
tips: Keep your chest pressed into the support pad instead of leaning back to finish the pull.
Squeeze your lats and shoulder blades together at the bottom of each repetition.
